cards.text: Friend, this word of the LORD comes to a man named Zephaniah son of Cushi, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah. The text even names four of Zephaniah's ancestors, all the way back to Hezekiah. Me, my whole family history is one price sticker that said 25 cents.
Then the LORD speaks, and He does NOT ease into it. He says He will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth.

cards.question: The LORD names what He will sweep away: man and beast, the birds and the fish. True or false: He also names the idols with their wicked worshipers.

cards.text: Then the LORD gets closer to home. He says He will stretch out His hand against Judah and all who dwell in Jerusalem, which is like the boss calling a meeting and YOUR name is on the agenda.

cards.question: Along with every remnant of Baal, the LORD says He will cut off from this place the names of the idolatrous and pagan ___.

cards.text: Then the LORD describes who He means. Some people bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven.

cards.question: Others bow down and swear by the LORD. What does the LORD say is the problem with these people?

cards.text: Swearing by the LORD and by Milcom is like wearing two team jerseys to the same game and hoping NOBODY notices. Then the LORD names one more group: those who turn back from following the LORD.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says those who turn back from following Him still seek Him and inquire of Him.

cards.text: Then the voice shifts, and the call is to be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer counting dust, and even I can tell this is a whole different level of quiet.

cards.question: Why the call to be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD?

answers.text: The Day of the LORD is near
The king of Judah has died

cards.text: Then comes a striking line. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice, and He has consecrated His guests.

cards.question: On the Day of the LORD's sacrifice, who does the LORD name first for punishment?

answers.text: The princes and the sons of the king
The soldiers at the city gates

cards.question: After the princes and the sons of the king, the LORD names one more group for the Day of the LORD's sacrifice: all who are dressed in ___ apparel.

cards.text: The LORD isn't done naming names. On that day, He says, He will punish all who leap over the threshold.

cards.question: The LORD says the people who leap over the threshold fill their master's house with what?

cards.text: The LORD keeps going. On that day, He says, a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District and a loud crashing from the hills, like the whole city's group chat blowing up at the same time.

cards.question: Then the LORD tells the dwellers of the Hollow to wail. Why?

answers.text: Their wells will all run dry
Their king will be taken away

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will search Jerusalem, and not with a quick glance either. This is checking every corner.

cards.question: The LORD says He will search Jerusalem with ___.

cards.text: Back in the junk drawer I would have LOVED somebody coming through with a lamp, but friend, this is not that kind of search. The LORD is looking for the men settled in complacency.

cards.question: What do these complacent men in Jerusalem say to themselves?

answers.text: The LORD will do nothing either good or bad
The LORD will protect us no matter what
The LORD only judges the other nations

cards.text: So the LORD says what happens to them. Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says these complacent men will build houses and get to live in them.

cards.text: They'll build houses but not live in them, and plant vineyards but never drink the wine. That's like working overtime all year for a vacation and NEVER getting to take it.
Then the LORD sounds an alarm, and it is NOT the snooze-button kind: the great Day of the LORD is near, near and coming quickly.

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says that on that day the mighty will stand strong and unshaken.
The LORD stacks up what that day will be, one line after another. Which of these is on the list?

answers.text: A day of darkness and gloom
A day of famine and drought
A day of plague and sickness

cards.question: True or false: the LORD says that day will also be a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will bring such distress on mankind that it changes the way people even walk. And He says why.

cards.question: The LORD says people will walk like the ___, because they have ___ against the LORD.

cards.text: The LORD says their blood will be poured out like dust. Then He names the thing people lean on when trouble shows up.

cards.question: What does the LORD say won't be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD's wrath?

cards.text: The LORD says the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy. Then the last line: He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth, and friend, this chapter does NOT end soft.
